subject.title: fix(code-mode): bound and simplify worker lifecycles

question: After rebasing onto current main, should OpenClaw adopt this single lifecycle watchdog and scheduled snapshot-expiry contract for all Code Mode execution paths?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes cross-cutting runtime timing and cleanup semantics; test evidence is strong, but accepting the resulting operational contract is a maintainer decision rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Rebase and accept the unified lifecycle
options.body: Rebase the branch, rerun the supplied real-worker lifecycle coverage, and merge if the owner confirms concurrent bridge settlement remains intact.

options.title: Keep separate lifecycle boundaries
options.body: Reject the consolidation if maintainers prefer distinct initialization and execution deadlines despite the added complexity.
